properties.displayName: UAV S18 - MAVLink Unsigned Message Burst (MITM Indicator)
properties.description: UAVMavsec_CL에서 UnsignedCount z-score 이상 AND FailedCount > 0 동시 발생, 또는 비인가 PeerIp와 동시에 탐지. MITRE: T0842 Network Sniffing, T1692 Unauthorized Message
properties.query:
let baselineWindow = 24h;
let alertWindow = 10m;
let zThreshold = 3.0;
let KnownGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
let MavsecAnomaly =
    UAVMavsec_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(baselineWindow)
    | make-series AvgUnsigned=avg(UnsignedCount), AvgFailed=avg(FailedCount)
        on TimeGenerated step 5m by UAVId
    | extend (UA, US, UB) = series_decompose_anomalies(AvgUnsigned, zThreshold)
    | mv-expand TimeGenerated, AvgUnsigned=todouble(AvgUnsigned),
        UA=toint(UA), AvgFailed=todouble(AvgFailed)
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where UA == 1 or AvgFailed > 0
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, AvgUnsigned, AvgFailed;
let SuspectConn =
    UAVDatalinkConn_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | join kind=leftanti (KnownGCS) on $left.PeerIp == $right.GCS_IP
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, PeerIp;
MavsecAnomaly
| join kind=leftouter (SuspectConn) on UAVId
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    AvgFailed > 0 and isnotnull(PeerIp), "MAVLink_서명실패_비인가IP_동시",
    AvgFailed > 0, "MAVLink_서명검증_실패",
    "MAVLink_무서명메시지_급증")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, AvgUnsigned, AvgFailed, PeerIp, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S18 - MAVLink Unsigned Message Burst (MITM Indicator) - {{UAVId}}
